propositions: gate_dispatch.py exceeds the 800 LOC soft cap at 907 LOC and must be reduced.
The code-review post-verdict finalization cluster is extracted into a new strict-leaf module code_review/finalize.py that imports nothing from gate_dispatch.
The success-branch body of _run_code_review_gate is factored into finalize_code_review_verdict, leaving _run_code_review_gate a thin sequencer delegating via lazy import.
finalize.py re-declares STEP_VERIFY/STEP_DECIDE/_LLM_STEP_KINDS as local private constants to avoid a back-import, a mechanical rename with identical string values.
gate_dispatch re-exports _attach_code_review_metrics for back-compat because tests call it at seven sites.
gate_dispatch is removed from the module-size allowlist and ceilings files and its remedy row deleted from the architecture offenders table.
